source:
@@U04415@@
I think of it even today. Something wrong there, I'd say. Something not right.

@@U04417@@
Can the Emperor have sinned in giving him the seashore? Didn't a herald proclaim it throughout the land? Well, the first foothold was planted not far from our dunes. Tents and huts! And before we knew it there was a palace in the midst of green meadows and trees.

@@U04419@@
All day long workers toiled and slaved, pick and shovel forever hacking away, and all for nothing. But at night we saw little flames swarming everywhere, and the next day— there stood the dam. Men were sacrificed, you could hear them at night howling in their torment. Floods of flame flowed seaward, and at morning light we beheld a canal. He’s a godless man. He covets our cottage and our grove of lindens. He boasts of being neighborly, but expects us to be his slaves.

@@U04421@@
Yet he offered us a nice property on the new-made land.
translation:
@@U04415@@
直到今天我仍然在想。我想说，那里有问题。有什么不对劲。

@@U04417@@
难道皇帝把海岸赐给他是有罪的吗？不是有传令官在全国范围内宣布过吗？嗯，第一个立足点就在离我们的沙丘不远的地方。帐篷和小屋！不知不觉中，绿色的草地和树木中出现了一座宫殿。

@@U04419@@
工人们整天辛苦劳作、辛勤劳作、镐子铲子不停地砍伐，但一切都是徒劳。但到了晚上，我们看到到处都是小火苗，第二天——大坝就矗立在那里了。男人被牺牲了，你可以在晚上听到他们在痛苦中嚎叫。火焰如洪水般涌向大海，黎明时分，我们看到了一条运河。他是一个无神论者。他觊觎我们的小屋和椴树丛。他自诩和蔼可亲，却希望我们成为他的奴隶。

@@U04421@@
然而他在新土地上为我们提供了一套不错的房产。
